subject: Writing letter as ÅÄÖ in Shiny.

messages.author: 2630fb3baf887061
messages.subject: Writing letter as ÅÄÖ in Shiny.
parts:
Hi,

My problem is that i need to write something in the Swedish language and when i have for a ex. helpText("ÅÄÖ"), or with any other text-string that contains the letters åäö i get the errors:

Warning in checkEncoding(file) :
  The input file C:/.../.../.../.../... .R does not seem to be encoded in UTF8
Warning in readLines(file, warn = FALSE) :
  invalid input found on input connection 'C:/.../.../.../.../... .R'
Error in parse(file, keep.source = FALSE, srcfile = src, encoding = enc) : 
  C:/.../.../.../.../... .R:35:28: unexpected INCOMPLETE_STRING
34:                 sidebarPanel(
35:                   helpText("ÅÄÖ
                               ^

Does any one know what to do to?

Cheers

messages.author: 2630fb3baf887061
messages.subject: Re: Writing letter as ÅÄÖ in Shiny.
parts: Solved with typing å = \xe5, ä = \xe4, ö = \xf6 in the text-string
